brief.headline: Ask them to match our ₹290.00/KG price from Shrinath and cut ₹32.69 L/yr — we're 9.72% of their sales and they need faster payment more than most.

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match ₹290.00/KG for the top three items, saving us ₹32.69 L/yr
priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹290.00/KG to Shrinath Roto Pack for very similar laminates — three big items are 1.4%, 6.3% and 1.6% higher. The market typical price is ₹250/kg, so our ₹290–294 band is at the top of fair; matching our best price is reasonable and market-fair.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 15 days (instead of 30) in exchange for a price cut of about 2%
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days faster frees up ₹1.16 Cr of our cash, so we need a clear price cut to make it worthwhile — their borrowing rate is in the 1.55-9.25% range, so early payment is worth roughly that to them

brief.financialLeverage: They keep only ₹1 of every ₹100 they sell (1.1% profit), half what similar firms do (2.1%), so a big price squeeze could hurt supply. But their cash is stuck for 81 days — much longer than the 46 days typical for peers — which means they're cash-tight and will value faster payment. We buy ₹28.31 Cr from them every year, which is 9.72% of their total ₹291.36 Cr revenue — we're a huge customer, so they'll work to keep us. Push payment terms first (they need the cash) and ask for the price match as part of keeping our volume.

evidence.point: We're a big customer — nearly 10% of everything they sell
Their cash is stuck longer than most — 81 days vs 46 days for similar firms
We pay ₹32.69 L/yr more than our cheapest supplier for similar laminates
They keep very little profit — only 1.1% vs 2.1% for peers
CRISIL rating is BB+ / Stable but the company stopped cooperating with the rating agency
Paying 15 days faster frees up ₹1.16 Cr of our cash
evidence.figure: ₹1.16 Cr working capital freed if 15 days faster

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Global group's India converter for pharma blister and sachet laminates — strong second-source candidate

risks: They're our main source — 76% of our laminate spend (₹28.31 Cr) comes from them, so pushing too hard without a second source lined up could disrupt supply
The CRISIL BB+ rating was done without their help, so their real financial health may be worse than the data shows — keep supply continuity top of mind
GST filing delays, EPF payment delays and pending legal cases are red flags — qualify a backup supplier before you squeeze hard

Their profit is paper-thin (1.1%) and they're burning cash (₹-1.64 Cr free cash flow) — a big price cut alone could tip them over; tie any cut to faster payment or more volume so it's a trade, not just a hit
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: You're a key supplier — nearly 10% of your business — and we want to grow that, but we need you at ₹290/kg to match our best price and we'd like to talk about paying you faster to help your cash flow.
